COLLATERAL_ID='CMG30943' (UPDATED) .
COLLATERAL_ID='CMG31703' (DELETED) . 
COLLATERAL_ID='DCT25745' (UNCHANGED) .
COLLATERAL_ID='9999' (NEW RECORD) . 

select COLLATERAL_ID COLLATERAL_ID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT COLLATERAL_ID COLLATERAL_ID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_CCOLTRLLNKMNT WHERE COLLATERAL_ID='CMG30943'
UNION ALL
SELECT COLLATERAL_ID COLLATERAL_ID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_CCOLTRLLNKMNT WHERE COLLATERAL_ID='CMG31703'
UNION ALL
SELECT COLLATERAL_ID COLLATERAL_ID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_CCOLTRLLNKMNT WHERE COLLATERAL_ID='DCT25745'
UNION ALL
SELECT COLLATERAL_ID COLLATERAL_ID2, * FROM
EDS.LNS_CCOLTRLLNKMNT WHERE COLLATERAL_ID='9999' ) temp order by COLLATERAL_ID, SCD_START_DATE
